parameters.content:
## Live deployment notes - NOT part of this demo

This workflow is SIMULATED. No real WhatsApp message was sent and no live API was called.

A live deployment still needs, all supplied by the client or Nitesh (none present here):
- A Meta developer app and a WhatsApp Business number, with webhook verification completed in Meta.
- The WhatsApp Cloud API send endpoint replacing the mock .invalid URL.
- Environment variables, by name only (no values stored anywhere in this demo): WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY.
- An OpenAI node (see the DISABLED node below) enabled and connected only after a key is supplied through n8n credentials, never pasted into a workflow file.

Do not present this demo as a delivered client bot or a production deployment.

nodes.name: OpenAI Reply (DISABLED - live variant only)
nodes.notes: DISABLED live-variant placeholder. Not connected to any other node. To use it in a live deployment: supply the key through n8n credentials using the environment variable name OPENAI_API_KEY, enable this node, and connect it in place of the mock Reply Composer. No key is stored in this file.
